title: Where You Hang Your Enemy's Head...
description: Nazir directs the player to Delvin Mallory at The Ragged Flagon in Riften to purchase upgrades and restore the Dawnstar Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. After buying all available upgrades from Delvin, the sanctuary is fully refurnished and the quest completes.

base_facts: Nazir is a Redguard assassin of the Dark Brotherhood who survived the attack on the old sanctuary.
Nazir now resides in the Dawnstar Sanctuary and oversees its operations.
Nazir can direct the player to Delvin Mallory for sanctuary renovations.

NAZIR_DIRECTS_TO_DELVIN: Nazir has sent the player to speak with Delvin Mallory about restoring the Dawnstar Sanctuary.
SANCTUARY_FULLY_RESTORED: Nazir's Dawnstar Sanctuary has been fully refitted and restored, marking a new era for the Dark Brotherhood.
Nazir now oversees a fully renovated sanctuary complete with an alchemy lab, torture chamber, secret entrance, and master bedroom.

base_facts: Delvin Mallory is a member of the Thieves Guild operating out of The Ragged Flagon in Riften.
Delvin offers renovation services for the Dawnstar Sanctuary for gold.
Delvin sells upgrades including new banners, a Poisoner's Nook with an alchemy lab, a torture chamber, a secret entrance, and a master bedroom.

DELVIN_UPGRADES_AVAILABLE: Delvin has discussed the available sanctuary upgrades with the player.
SANCTUARY_FULLY_RESTORED: Delvin confirms all renovations to the Dawnstar Sanctuary are complete; he has nothing more he can offer for it.
All sanctuary upgrades have been purchased from Delvin at a total cost of 19,000 gold.
Delvin has installed every available upgrade: new banners, the Poisoner's Nook with its alchemy lab and regrowing ingredient garden, a torture chamber, a secret entrance, and a master bedroom.

beats.comment: Nazir tells the player to seek Delvin Mallory at The Ragged Flagon for sanctuary repairs.
Player speaks to Delvin about available sanctuary upgrades at The Ragged Flagon.
All upgrades purchased; Delvin confirms nothing more he can do. Quest completes at stage 200.
